status: Design proposal only; no additional source accessed for fit and no new comparison run.
decision: Defer new adaptive-backoff estimator comparison. Prefer prospectively fixed increased training coverage using unchanged six Cycle34 conditions.
proposed_roles: Same train drummers1–6; same eight already observed diagnostic recordings from drummers7–10. All eval_session recordings remain reserved. No new independent validation claim.
candidate_design: Nested baseline twelve versus at most36 whole training performances (up to6 per training drummer), source-SHA then ID ordering, retain original twelve, no score-guided choice. Maximum4096events per whole performance, maximum60000total training events, no truncation. Source list and feasible bound must be frozen before any fit.
guardrails: Metadata-first candidate selection with exact source hashes and rights attribution; do not acquire audio.

Pre-fit crosssplit exact bytes, full tempo/offset-normalized onset/instrument signatures and fixed coarse-window pattern screen; unresolved strong matches quarantine before fit with no score-driven replacement.
Withintrain duplicate/family and session relationships reported, not counted as independent compositions.
Freeze all six existing estimators, same support/priors and per-drummer/recording denominators. CPU60, no parameter search or generation.

The current model total30000-event bound must not be silently bypassed: prospectively bound/review a separate profile, or declare preparation blocked if selected complete-source total exceeds supported bound.
confounds: More performances also change content, instrument mix, duration and style coverage; note count alone is not isolated.
Existing hash-order baseline includes very short fills and unbalanced event mass. Expanded counts need per-drummer and per-style metadata descriptions without attributing causal effects to style.
Repeatedly measuring the same eight is exploratory; new held-out material would require separately authorized pre-score screening.
next_action: Parent may authorize metadata preparation and source-bound plan; actual expanded fit requires explicit review. No new source use is recorded by this proposal.
